{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

A channel carries symbols from a sender to a receiver, and noise corrupts some of them.
This page measures how much information a channel can carry,
using the [mutual information](entropy.qmd#sec-mutual-information)
between what goes in and what comes out.
